notes: CAMO GRIND: every gun now has its own camo challenges - open the LOCKER, pick a gun and go to CHALLENGES. 8 military camos per gun, then GOLD, DIAMOND (whole class) and NOVA (every gun)
BOT LOADOUTS: bots now carry real guns with random attachments and camos - you can see them in their hands, and the kill feed names the gun
Bots pick guns that fit their job: overwatch snipers and marksman rifles, entries SMGs and shotguns, support ARs and LMGs, lurkers often suppressed
Bot guns fight like the real thing: damage, fire rate, magazine, effective range and drop-off. Suppressed bots show no tracers or flash and are heard from less far away
